function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Shashi Tej Reddy** is a former Indian Army officer who entered politics in the state of Telangana.  
He served as a minister in the Telangana state cabinet, most notably holding the portfolio of **Food & Civil Supplies**. Reddy was elected to the Telangana Legislative Assembly and was a prominent member of the **Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS)** party.  

During his political career he was known for his outspoken style and was involved in several controversies, including allegations of corruption and misuse of power. Despite this, he remained a significant figure in Telangana politics until his resignation from the cabinet in 2018 following a scandal involving the procurement of food grains.
